fields.statement: At 1a855d1c I read the diff of 8c465daa and 1a855d1c and ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'OtherWorkflow|DispatchedWorkflow'. All pass. TestDaemonStartsRequestWithDispatchedWorkflow: with a dispatch.toml of [request] bug=bugfix and milestone=roadmap, a bug request starts --workflow bugfix --new, a feature request starts --workflow plan, and a milestone request starts --workflow roadmap --milestone without --autonomous. TestRunResumeGatesMilestonePlanUnderOtherWorkflow: an autonomous Plan run under roadmap on a record change set hits the milestone owner gate. TestInboxKeepsPlanRunUnderOtherWorkflow: the inbox keeps it listed (not skipped). TestRunResumeLetsLandedPlanRunUnderOtherWorkflow: run.resume lets a Plan run under bugfix on a landed change set through, and refuses a non-plan run that never reached land. This answers attempt 1's finding f1. TestResumablePlanRunUnderOtherWorkflow in internal/daemon shows Resumable keeps the landed plan run under bugfix. ./internal/daemon, ./internal/run, ./internal/dispatch and the cmd/rhiza scripts run-start-new, request* and daemon* all pass. The keying is run.State.IsPlanRun (Started.Plan, set when the run is started with --new, or a legacy plan workflow). It is used in Resumable, inboxItems and both run.resume checks.
